summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and financial results impacting the retail and finance sectors, crucial for strategic planning.

bullets.text: Bombay High Court rules firecracker ban applies year-round for all festivals, impacting public celebrations.
Calcutta High Court permits CPI(M) to set up a book stall near its office, supporting diverse ideologies.
AG consents to contempt of court case against Nikhil Wagle and Sanjay Raut over remarks on CJI Kant.
Myntra reports a net loss of Rs 579 crore in FY26, with revenue declining by 13%.
IIFL Finance's Q2 profit nearly doubles to Rs 805 crore, with assets under management rising by 38%.
